data.summary: L'IA/ML est présentée comme un pilier stratégique de McKesson Corporation (MCK) dans son 10-K, avec des mentions étendues et des signaux d'investissement ou de leadership explicites.

evidence.quote: Our investments in AI may not yield anticipated benefits, and we might expend significant resources to maintain responsible and effective AI capabilities.

We are in the early stages of exploring potential AI capabilities and related data and analytics across our enterprise to improve productivity and efficiency, as well as enhance our products and services to better support patients, employees, and customers.
